name: Mirror or offsetting transactions between jurisdictions
description: Reciprocal or offsetting payments occur between counterparties or operators in different countries with no direct value transfer.
fp: Netting and reciprocal arrangements between related businesses.

links.name: Reciprocal payments between operators across countries
links.ctx: Payments in and out between linked accounts without a direct transfer.

links.name: Mirror or offsetting transactions between jurisdictions
links.ctx: Payments in one country are balanced by payments elsewhere without movement of funds between them.
links.fp: Netting and bank-to-bank settlement may look similar.

links.name: Chinese-underground-banking or mirror-transaction style offsets
links.ctx: Payments settled by matching transactions in different countries without cross-border transfers.
